```{r}

# Fonction de forme puissance
A <- function(t, a1, a2) {
  return(a1 * t^a2)
}

# Vraisemblance 
vraisemblance <- function(param, Y, t) {
  l_t <- length(t)
  delta_A <- A(t[2:l_t], param[1], param[2]) - A(t[1:(l_t-1)], param[1], param[2])
  Y <- Y[-1, ]
  res <- suppressWarnings(
    -sum( delta_A*log(param[3]) - log(gamma(delta_A)) + (delta_A - 1)*log(Y) - param[3]*Y ))
  return(res)
}
# Pont gamma : Approche d'Edith Grall
gamma_bridge <- function(X, t, a) {
  n <- length(X) - 1
  t_n <- t[length(t)]
  teq <- t_n / n
  t_star <- seq(0, t_n, teq)
  
  Y <- numeric(length(t_star))
  Y[1] <- 0
  
  for (i in 2:n) {
    inter <- max(t[t <= t_star[i]])
    if (inter > t_star[i-1]) {
      t_inf <- inter
      x_inf <- X[t == inter]
    } else {
      t_inf <- t_star[i-1]
      x_inf <- Y[i-1]
    }
    t_sup <- min(t[t > t_star[i]])
    x_sup <- X[t == t_sup]
    y <- rbeta(1, a * (t_star[i] - t_inf), a * (t_sup - t_star[i]))
    Y[i] <- x_inf + (x_sup - x_inf) * y
  }
  Y[n+1] <- X[n+1]
  
  return(list(teq = teq, new_obs = Y))
}
```



```{r}
# ============================================================================
# PARAMÈTRES DE LA PROCÉDURE
# ============================================================================

n <- nrow(X) - 1           # nombre d'observations par trajectoire
T <- ncol(X)               # nombre de trajectoires
t <- seq(0, 0.9, 0.1)      # instants d'observation

B <- 2000                  # nombre de réplications bootstrap
alpha_G <- 0.017           # niveau pour chaque test individuel
n_tot <- n * T             # nombre total d'observations

# Paramètres pour les tests
l <- 2                     # pour le test de stationnarité
d <- 3                     # pour le test d'indépendance
```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
#  ESTIMATION MLE
# ============================================================================

# Calcul des incréments
Y_process <- rbind(0, X[2:10, ] - X[1:9, ])

# Optimisation MLE
res <- optim(c(1000, 1, 200), vraisemblance, Y = Y_process, t = t)
a1_est <- res$par[1]
a2_est <- res$par[2]
b_est <- res$par[3]

cat("Estimations MLE:")
cat("  a1 =", a1_est)
cat("  a2 =", a2_est)
cat("  b  =", b_est)
```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
#  TRANSFORMATION DE CINLAR
# ============================================================================

t_new <- A(t, a1_est, a2_est)
Z <- b_est * X     
```


```{r}
# ============================================================================
#  PROCÉDURE DU PONT GAMMA
# ============================================================================

Z_fin <- matrix(0, nrow = n+1, ncol = T)
bridge_result <- gamma_bridge(Z[, 1], t_new, 1)
teq <- bridge_result$teq

for (k in 1:T) {
  Z_fin[, k] <- gamma_bridge(Z[, k], t_new, 1)$new_obs
}

# Incréments finaux
X_final <- c(t(Z_fin[2:(n+1), ] - Z_fin[1:n, ]))
head(X_final)
```

```{r}
# ============================================================================
#  TEST GOF POUR LOI GAMMA
# ============================================================================

gof_gamma_test <- function(X, B = 2000, alpha = 0.017) {
  
  henze <- function(X, inter) {
    n <- length(X)
    alpha <- inter[1]
    beta <- inter[2]
    Y <- beta * X
    prod <- Y %*% t(Y)
    somme <- outer(Y, Y, "+")
    a_param <- 1
    Tstat <- sum((prod - alpha * somme + alpha^2) / (somme + a_param) +
                 (2 * prod - alpha * somme) / (somme + a_param)^2 +
                 2 * prod / (somme + a_param)^3) / n
    return(Tstat)
  }
  
  n_tot <- length(X)
  alpha_G <- alpha
  alpha_G1 <- alpha_G / 2
  alpha_G2 <- 1 - alpha_G / 2
  alpha_G3 <- 1 - alpha_G
  
  inter <- fitdistr(X, "gamma")$estimate
  
  B6 <- numeric(B)
  B9 <- numeric(B)
  for (j in 1:B) {
    Y <- rgamma(n_tot, inter[1], inter[2])
    inter_bis <- fitdistr(Y, "gamma")$estimate
    B6[j] <- gamma_test(Y)$statistic
    B9[j] <- henze(Y, inter_bis)
  }
  
  B_Vil_1 <- quantile(B6, alpha_G1)
  B_Vil_2 <- quantile(B6, alpha_G2)
  B_Hen <- quantile(B9, alpha_G3)
  
  Vil <- gamma_test(X)$statistic
  Hen <- henze(X, inter)
  
  reject_Vil <- (Vil <= B_Vil_1) || (Vil >= B_Vil_2)
  reject_Hen <- (Hen >= B_Hen)
  
  return(c(reject_Vil, reject_Hen))
}
```

# Niveau et puissance des tests

```{r}
library(MASS)
library(npcp)
library(copula)
library(statmod)
library(goft)

rm(list = ls())

A <- function(t, a1, a2) {
  return(a1 * t^a2)
}

vraisemblance <- function(param, Y, t) {
  l_t <- length(t)
  delta_A <- A(t[2:l_t], param[1], param[2]) - A(t[1:(l_t-1)], param[1], param[2])
  Y <- Y[-1, ]
  if (any(delta_A <= 0)) return(1e300)
  res <- suppressWarnings(
    -sum(delta_A * log(param[3]) - log(gamma(delta_A)) + (delta_A - 1) * log(Y) - param[3] * Y)
  )
  return(res)
}

gamma_bridge <- function(X, t, a) {
  n <- length(X) - 1
  t_n <- t[length(t)]
  teq <- t_n / n
  t_star <- seq(0, t_n, teq)
  Y <- numeric(length(t_star))
  Y[1] <- 0
  for (i in 2:n) {
    if (any(abs(t_star[i] - t) < 1e-8)) {
      Y[i] <- X[t == t_star[i]]
      next
    }
    inter <- max(t[t <= t_star[i]])
    if (inter > t_star[i-1]) {
      t_inf <- inter
      x_inf <- X[t == inter]
    } else {
      t_inf <- t_star[i-1]
      x_inf <- Y[i-1]
    }
    t_sup <- min(t[t > t_star[i]])
    x_sup <- X[t == t_sup]
    y <- rbeta(1, a * (t_star[i] - t_inf), a * (t_sup - t_star[i]))
    Y[i] <- x_inf + (x_sup - x_inf) * y
  }
  Y[n+1] <- X[n+1]
  return(list(teq = teq, new_obs = Y))
}

henze_stat <- function(X, inter) {
  n <- length(X)
  alpha <- inter[1]
  beta <- inter[2]
  Y <- beta * X
  prod <- Y %*% t(Y)
  somme <- outer(Y, Y, "+")
  a_param <- 1
  Tstat <- sum((prod - alpha * somme + alpha^2) / (somme + a_param) +
               (2 * prod - alpha * somme) / (somme + a_param)^2 +
               2 * prod / (somme + a_param)^3) / n
  return(Tstat)
}

run_test_both <- function(data, t_obs, B = 2000, alpha_G = 0.017) {
  n <- nrow(data) - 1
  T_traj <- ncol(data)
  t <- t_obs
  
  Y_process <- rbind(0, data[2:(n+1), ] - data[1:n, ])
  inc_vals <- as.vector(Y_process[-1, ])
  moy_inc <- mean(inc_vals)
  var_inc <- var(inc_vals)
  b_init <- var_inc / moy_inc
  a1_init <- (moy_inc * b_init) / (t[length(t)]^1)
  a2_init <- 1
  res <- tryCatch(
    optim(c(a1_init, a2_init, b_init), vraisemblance, Y = Y_process, t = t),
    error = function(e) list(par = c(1,1,1))
  )
  a1_est <- res$par[1]
  a2_est <- res$par[2]
  b_est <- res$par[3]
  
  t_new <- A(t, a1_est, a2_est)
  Z <- b_est * data
  
  Z_fin <- matrix(0, nrow = n+1, ncol = T_traj)
  bridge_temp <- gamma_bridge(Z[, 1], t_new, 1)
  teq <- bridge_temp$teq
  for (k in 1:T_traj) {
    Z_fin[, k] <- gamma_bridge(Z[, k], t_new, 1)$new_obs
  }
  X_final <- c(t(Z_fin[2:(n+1), ] - Z_fin[1:n, ]))
  
  stat_pval <- suppressWarnings(stDistAutocop(X_final, l = 2)$p.value)
  if (stat_pval < alpha_G) return(c(1,1))
  
  d_sim <- serialIndepTestSim(length(X_final), 3)
  indep_test <- serialIndepTest(X_final, d_sim)
  indep_pval <- indep_test$global.statistic.pvalue
  if (indep_pval < alpha_G) return(c(1,1))
  
  gamma_params <- fitdistr(X_final, "gamma")$estimate
  shape_hat <- gamma_params[1]
  rate_hat <- gamma_params[2]
  
  B_Hen <- numeric(B)
  for (j in 1:B) {
    Y_boot <- rgamma(length(X_final), shape = shape_hat, rate = rate_hat)
    inter_boot <- fitdistr(Y_boot, "gamma")$estimate
    B_Hen[j] <- henze_stat(Y_boot, inter_boot)
  }
  crit_Hen <- quantile(B_Hen, 1 - alpha_G)
  Hen_obs <- henze_stat(X_final, gamma_params)
  reject_Hen <- ifelse(Hen_obs >= crit_Hen, 1, 0)
  
  Vil_obs <- abs(as.numeric(gamma_test(X_final)$statistic))
  B_Vil <- numeric(B)
  for (j in 1:B) {
    Y_boot <- rgamma(length(X_final), shape = shape_hat, rate = rate_hat)
    B_Vil[j] <- abs(as.numeric(gamma_test(Y_boot)$statistic))
  }
  crit_low <- quantile(B_Vil, alpha_G/2)
  crit_high <- quantile(B_Vil, 1 - alpha_G/2)
  reject_Vil <- ifelse(Vil_obs <= crit_low || Vil_obs >= crit_high, 1, 0)
  
  return(c(reject_Hen, reject_Vil))
}

estimate_power_both <- function(Nsim, generate_data, B = 2000, alpha_G = 0.017) {
  reject_Hen <- numeric(Nsim)
  reject_Vil <- numeric(Nsim)
  for (i in 1:Nsim) {
    sim <- generate_data()
    data <- sim$data
    t_obs <- sim$t_obs
    res <- run_test_both(data, t_obs, B, alpha_G)
    reject_Hen[i] <- res[1]
    reject_Vil[i] <- res[2]
  }
  return(c(mean(reject_Hen), mean(reject_Vil)))
}

# Scenario H0 : gamma homogène (forme puissance)
scenario_H0 <- function() {
  T_traj <- 5
  n <- 10
  t_obs <- seq(0, 10, length.out = n+1)
  a1 <- 0.5
  a2 <- 1
  b <- 1
  data <- matrix(0, nrow = n+1, ncol = T_traj)
  for (k in 1:T_traj) {
    inc <- rgamma(n, shape = a1 * (t_obs[2:(n+1)]^a2 - t_obs[1:n]^a2), rate = b)
    data[, k] <- c(0, cumsum(inc))
  }
  return(list(data = data, t_obs = t_obs))
}

# Scenario incréments dépendants (MA(1))
scenario_dependent_increments <- function() {
  T_traj <- 5
  n <- 10
  t_obs <- seq(0, 10, length.out = n+1)
  a1 <- 0.5
  a2 <- 2
  b <- 1
  delta_A <- a1 * (t_obs[2:(n+1)]^a2 - t_obs[1:n]^a2)
  data <- matrix(0, nrow = n+1, ncol = T_traj)
  for (k in 1:T_traj) {
    Z <- rgamma(n+1, shape = c(delta_A[1], diff(c(0, delta_A))), rate = b)
    Y <- Z[-1] + Z[-(n+1)]
    data[, k] <- c(0, cumsum(Y))
  }
  return(list(data = data, t_obs = t_obs))
}

# Scenario non homogène (a2=1.5)
scenario_non_homogeneous <- function() {
  T_traj <- 5
  n <- 10
  t_obs <- seq(0, 10, length.out = n+1)
  a1 <- 0.5
  a2 <- 1.5
  b <- 1
  data <- matrix(0, nrow = n+1, ncol = T_traj)
  for (k in 1:T_traj) {
    inc <- rgamma(n, shape = a1 * (t_obs[2:(n+1)]^a2 - t_obs[1:n]^a2), rate = b)
    data[, k] <- c(0, cumsum(inc))
  }
  return(list(data = data, t_obs = t_obs))
}

# Scenario extended gamma (Cinlar) avec fonction de forme puissance (a2 variable)
# Ici on fixe a2 = 1 (linéaire) mais on peut le changer
scenario_extended_gamma <- function(a2 = 1) {
  T_traj <- 5
  n <- 10
  t_obs <- seq(0, 10, length.out = n+1)
  a1 <- 0.5
  b <- function(t) ifelse(t <= 5, 1, 10)
  data <- matrix(0, nrow = n+1, ncol = T_traj)
  for (k in 1:T_traj) {
    inc <- numeric(n)
    for (i in 1:n) {
      shape <- a1 * (t_obs[i+1]^a2 - t_obs[i]^a2)
      rate <- b((t_obs[i] + t_obs[i+1])/2)
      inc[i] <- rgamma(1, shape = shape, rate = rate)
    }
    data[, k] <- c(0, cumsum(inc))
  }
  return(list(data = data, t_obs = t_obs))
}

# Scenario random effect avec fonction de forme puissance (a2 variable)
scenario_random_effect <- function(a2 = 1, d = 1) {
  T_traj <- 5
  n <- 10
  t_obs <- seq(0, 10, length.out = n+1)
  a1 <- 0.5
  data <- matrix(0, nrow = n+1, ncol = T_traj)
  for (k in 1:T_traj) {
    b_k <- rgamma(1, shape = d, rate = d)
    inc <- rgamma(n, shape = a1 * (t_obs[2:(n+1)]^a2 - t_obs[1:n]^a2), rate = b_k)
    data[, k] <- c(0, cumsum(inc))
  }
  return(list(data = data, t_obs = t_obs))
}

# Exemple d'appel pour estimer niveau et puissance
Nsim <- 500
B <- 200
alpha_G <- 0.017

res_H0 <- estimate_power_both(Nsim, scenario_H0, B, alpha_G)
res_dep <- estimate_power_both(Nsim, scenario_dependent_increments, B, alpha_G)
res_nh <- estimate_power_both(Nsim, scenario_non_homogeneous, B, alpha_G)
res_ext_lin <- estimate_power_both(Nsim, function() scenario_extended_gamma(a2 = 1), B, alpha_G)
res_re_lin <- estimate_power_both(Nsim, function() scenario_random_effect(a2 = 1, d = 1), B, alpha_G)

results <- rbind(res_H0, res_dep, res_nh, res_ext_lin, res_re_lin)
colnames(results) <- c("Henze", "Villasenor")
rownames(results) <- c("H0", "Dependent", "NonHomog", "ExtendedGamma(a2=1)", "RandomEffect(a2=1,d=1)")
print(results)
```
